title: Match logarithmic rank loss with an exact PSD projection family
statement: For even k and m=2^k, let J_i be the diagonal sign-pattern matrices and P_i=1/2[[I,J_i],[J_i,I]]. They are rational PSD projections of rank r=m. Their variance has norm k, so sigma=sqrt(k), and every original-label signing has norm (k+|sum_i s_i|)/2. A balanced signing minimizes it at k/2, giving ratio (1/2)*sqrt(log2 r). This matches the proposed order and does not refute a C*sqrt(log(2r))*sigma theorem.
